# VisualBuild Hub products

Three separate devices/firmware workflows, not simultaneous modes on one board.

- FlexHub: phone-browser keyboard, mouse, shortcuts, macros and light drawing. Product: https://visualbuild.shop/flexhub.html ; guide: https://visualbuild.shop/guide.html . Game controller support removed for stability. Extended OS text input requires receiver setup; BL616 u4 adds experimental BLE transport, not confirmed application compatibility.
- TransferHub: bidirectional streaming between a Wi-Fi phone and USB computer browser. Protocol v2 required for reverse transfer. One file/direction at a time, no resume. Configured 4 GiB ceiling is not hardware-validated. Product: https://visualbuild.shop/transferhub.html ; guide: https://visualbuild.shop/transferhub-guide.html ; app: https://visualbuild.shop/transfer/ ; offline ZIP: https://visualbuild.shop/transfer/FlexHub-Offline.zip .
- StackHub: Chan WSS on the board, backend HTTP MCP through an authenticated USB browser bridge on the computer. Keep bridge page open. Supports URL or mcpServers JSON for one backend. Not board-direct backend access, not stdio, not an internet router. Product: https://visualbuild.shop/stackhub.html ; guide: https://visualbuild.shop/stackhub-guide.html .

TransferHub and StackHub checkout/prices are not configured; enquiries only. Do not infer hardware acceptance from software tests.
